pre_fix_code_path.two_late_successes_possible_effect: old generation could reconstruct CAN_DELEGATE after revocation

repair.mechanism: BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> read current generation -> always preserve completed probe as raw capability_trial -> update current capability only if generation still matches and current state is not REVOKED -> otherwise commit raw trial with UNKNOWN stale-completion receipt
